title: Gallstone illness that began on tour in Pensacola
summary: Punch tells of rice pudding in Pensacola, a doctor's warning about gallstones, his fear of surgery, and the hospital stay.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
